title: DOJ asks for Supreme Court to intervene on California ballot demands
description: On the eve of the Nov. 3 election, the Trump administration is hoping the Supreme Court will reverse lower courts that rejected its request to order California to set aside the ballots of thousands of people it says are "likely" noncitizens.

title: Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran
description: Democrats in Michigan are considering their options after Haley Stevens endorsed GOP candidate Mike Rogers for Senate. And the Gulf states are bracing for a possible U.S. attack on Iran after the midterms.

title: Two economists studied California's billionaire tax. They reached wildly different conclusions
description: What happens in California could shape how America taxes the superrich. But will its billionaire tax fill state coffers — or drain them?

title: 6 things to watch for on election night
description: Some of the key storylines to watch will center around various voters groups that have soured on President Trump during his second turn out.

title: When it comes to election pressure, this year's Georgia or Michigan could be anywhere
description: The districts that will decide control of the House and Senate next year are spread across the country. Voting officials in those places may face scrutiny and pressure they've never experienced.

title: What Vance's midterm push reveals about his potential 2028 bid
description: Vance's delivery is different from the president's but his speeches contain plenty of MAGA DNA.

title: Do you know signs of a stroke? BE FAST are the words to remember
description: Sen. Chris Murphy is expected to fully recover from his stroke. The acronym BE FAST can help you remember the symptoms of stroke and what to do when it happens: Call 911 quickly.

title: Haley Stevens endorses GOP candidate in Michigan Senate race, spurning Abdul El-Sayed
description: Rep. Haley Stevens was scheduled to attend a unity event today with Abdul El-Sayed, who beat her in the Democratic primary. Instead, she endorsed his Republican opponent, Mike Rogers.

title: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy is hospitalized with a stroke
description: Murphy's office says he was taken to the hospital this weekend after experiencing numbness in his arm. His chief of staff said he is responding well to treatment and expected to make a full recovery.

title: How to think about the midterms — and the political moment the country is in
description: Polls show Democrats with an advantage in the midterm election but there are potential limitations and results may take a while to roll in.
